scripts.image-size:preview: vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php workbench/image-size/PreviewTest.php && node workbench/image-size/preview.mjs && tailwindcss -i workbench/image-size/preview.css -o build/image-size/preview/preview.css --minify
scripts.workbench: npm run workbench:blade && npm run workbench:vue && npm run workbench:react
scripts.workbench:bare: tailwindcss -i workbench/bare/blade.css -o build/bare/blade.css && tailwindcss -i workbench/bare/vue.css -o build/bare/vue.css && tailwindcss -i workbench/bare/react.css -o build/bare/react.css
scripts.readme:showcase: node workbench/readme/icons.mjs && vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php workbench/readme/ReadmeTest.php && tailwindcss -i workbench/readme/readme.css -o build/readme/readme.css --minify && node workbench/readme/showcase.mjs
scripts.workbench:blade: mkdir -p build/workbench-media && cp workbench/media/*.jpg build/workbench-media/ && node workbench/icons.mjs && vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php workbench/WorkbenchTest.php && tailwindcss -i workbench/app.css -o build/workbench/app.css --minify
scripts.workbench:vue: tailwindcss -i workbench/vue/app.css -o build/vue-tokens.css --minify && vite build --config workbench/vue/vite.config.mjs
scripts.workbench:react: tailwindcss -i workbench/react/app.css -o build/react-tokens.css --minify && vite build --config workbench/react/vite.config.mjs
scripts.test:bare: npm run workbench:bare && STORYFEED_HOST=bare node workbench/alignment.mjs && STORYFEED_HOST=bare node workbench/wells.mjs && STORYFEED_HOST=bare node workbench/targets.mjs
